title: GuideLens Visual Accuracy Benchmark Case
description: Schema for a reference screenshot and ground-truth bounding box test case used by the GuideLens IoU accuracy harness.

id.description: Unique identifier for the benchmark case (e.g. photoshop_object_selection_01).

app.description: Target application slug or display name from the 15 priority Windows apps (e.g. photoshop, vscode, excel, after_effects).

active_app_title.description: Simulated active window title passed to the brain in active_app_title.

query.description: Natural-language user question or goal passed to GuideLens.

image_path.description: Relative path from benchmarks/cases/ to the reference screenshot PNG/JPEG.

step_number.description: Which step index (1-based) in StepPlan.steps to evaluate against bbox.

target_name.description: Expected UI control name (also used for UIA snapping verification).

control_type.description: Expected Windows UIA control type hint (e.g. Button, MenuItem, Edit, TabItem).

bbox.description: Ground-truth bounding box [x, y, width, height] in normalized 0-1000 coordinates relative to the captured monitor.

min_iou.description: Minimum Intersection-over-Union threshold required for this case to pass (default 0.5).

mock_prediction.description: Optional deterministic StepPlan payload used for offline CI self-tests (--brain mock).

notes.description: Optional notes on UI layout, theme, or DPI scaling.
